migration: v2 adds agents_read_messages (the Agent Streams plan, S5: 'Agents don't read my messages'). A v1 record upgrades to a v2 record that reads true: joining a Co-pilot room and writing in it is the choice, and the person can take it back.
description: How chat looks for this person on every site with OpenVibe chat: timestamps, compact messages, text size, badges and emotes, and whether an AI agent may read their messages (the Co-pilot rooms of the Agent Streams plan, S5).

agents_read_messages.description: Whether an AI agent may read this person's chat messages. True by default: joining a Co-pilot room and writing in it is the choice, and it can be taken back. When false the digest leaves this person out entirely.
